title: contextator chart values
description: Deliberately narrow: it rejects the one value this chart must never accept (replicaCount other than 1, ADR-0078) and checks the shape of the top-level maps. It does not mark image.tag or the database as required and does not type scalar values such as image.tag or config.trustProxy, because `--set` infers types (`--set image.tag=0.1` is a number) and the templates' own `required`/`fail` checks already produce the specific error messages for those. Draft-07 because Helm v3 validates with gojsonschema, which supports drafts 4, 6 and 7 only.

replicaCount.description: Not a setting: the chart always renders exactly one replica (ADR-0078). MCP sessions live in process memory and the indexer runs in-process, so a second Pod would split both. The key is absent from values.yaml; any value other than 1 is rejected here so `--set replicaCount=2` fails instead of being silently ignored.
